Ava (Product): Quick UX check on the 'Rotate key' warning modal. We need clearer copy when keys are used by external services. Figma: https://figma.redwood/keys-rotate-warning :slightly_smiling_face:

Liam (Design): Current modal shows a generic warning. Suggest split copy: short alert headline + a details row listing impacted services (best-effort). Also include a 'Preview impact' link to expand details rather than dumping everything by default.

Hana (Eng): Backend can surface a best-effort count of references. We should label it: 'Detected uses: N (best-effort)'. We can't guarantee completeness. Also note we can offer an optional grace period checkbox to keep both keys valid for X hours.

Theo (UX Writer): Copy draft: Headline: 'Rotating this key may break integrations.' Short lead: 'We detected X services that might use this key. This scan is best-effort and may miss some usages.' Inline detail link: 'Preview detected services'. Confirm CTA: 'Rotate key' (danger), secondary: 'Cancel'. If user selects force-rotate add a small red inline note: 'Forces rotation even when references are detected.'

Rae (Accessibility): A11y items: 1) the details expansion should be keyboard-toggleable and announce item counts via aria-live. 2) the detected services list must be tab-navigable and SR-friendly with concise labels. 3) when grace period is toggled, update the preview text and ensure SR announces the new expiry window. 4) color should not be sole indicator of danger; use icon + text.

Hana (Eng): Also consider performance: running deep scans on large orgs may take time. If scan is in progress show a spinner and message 'Scanning references; results may be incomplete.' Allow user to proceed while scan runs (show probable count).

Ava (Product): Solid. Action items: @Liam update modal with expandable preview and grace-period control, @Theo finalize short/long copy + force-rotate variant, @Rae quick a11y pass on the PR, @Hana doc scan caveats and spinner behavior. I'll gather final strings for i18n. Thanks! :thumbsup:
